title: PRIME: Process Real-time Intelligence for Manufacturing Excellence
subtitle: Milestone II: UI/UX Design
lines: CSC 4330 Software System Development · Milestone #2 · Fall 2026

blocks.text: Sixteen colors from our Figma frame plus one derived warning tint, grouped by job. A warm, quiet base keeps attention free for the moments that need it; blue only marks things you can act on.

blocks.text: Following ISA-101 high-performance HMI practice, the normal state is warm gray and white. Saturated color appears only when an operator must act, so it is never ignored.
Steel blue from the logo is reserved for buttons, links and focus. Structural surfaces use charcoal so blue never gets diluted.
Predictions are always violet and dashed, so a model suggestion is never confused with a measured value or an alarm.
Every status pairs color with an icon and a text label, which keeps our red/green pair readable for the ~8 % of men with color-vision deficiency.
All text/background pairs checked: WCAG 2.1 AA. Ochre fails text contrast on white (3.6:1), so warning text stays in text on warn-50.
We sketched the seven main screens on paper together, then redrew them digitally so every route stays readable. Arrows show how people move between screens; each label names the trigger.
